423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

429-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-complete.text:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.>

$N is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

Let us hope that these failures are rare.

I'll give you the potion in a moment.
429-complete.title: Wild Hearts

439-accept.name: Corpse Laden Boat
439-accept.text:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  $N is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
439-accept.title: Rot Hide Clues

478-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
478-complete.text:
Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.

$N is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.

Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.
478-complete.title: Maps and Runes

481-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
481-complete.text:
Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. $N was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.

That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.

I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.
481-complete.title: Dalar's Analysis

482-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
482-accept.text:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

$N will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
482-accept.title: Dalaran's Intentions

7826-progress.name: Rashona Straglash
7826-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Orgrimmar for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7826-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

92421-accept.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-accept.text:
As a $c of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421-accept.title: Light's Justice

92460-accept.name: Ailee Farheart
92460-accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

<Ailee smiles kindly.>

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460-accept.title: Coming of Age

92460-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92460-complete.text:
Gale's greetings, $N. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.

Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.

As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.
92460-complete.title: Coming of Age

92461-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-accept.text:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461-accept.title: Harmony in Balance

92462-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-accept.text:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462-accept.title: Infestation Investigation

99-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
99-progress.text: Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, $N?
99-progress.title: Arugal's Folly
